description.value: The Kaleden Branch is a small public library serving the rural community of Kaleden, BC, roughly 15 km south of Penticton, as part of the Okanagan Regional Library system. It offers borrowing, digital resources, and community programming in a compact neighbourhood setting. A 24/7 outdoor book drop is located to the right of the front entrance.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Kaleden branch address (101 Linden Avenue) and phone ((250) 497-8066), matching OSM. The site mentions 'Free public parking is available in front of the library' (car parking only) and a 24/7 outdoor book drop, but makes no mention of bike racks, washrooms, water, or Wi-Fi at this branch — the OSM internet_access=wlan tag cannot be confirmed from website content per the rules. The OSM name 'Kalenden' is a misspelling; the library's own website and the ORL system consistently use 'Kaleden'.
concerns: OSM name spells the community 'Kalenden' but the library's own website and the ORL system consistently use 'Kaleden' — likely a typo in OSM.
None of the key cyclist amenities are explicitly mentioned on the website; all required criteria remain unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This very small branch library has no confirmed cycling amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water, Wi-Fi) from the website; it could serve as a rest stop but insufficient evidence exists to confirm it meets any WWC required criteria.

wow_evidence: Small rural branch; ordinary library band. Branch name misspelled in record (Kalenden).
blurb: Kaleden's small library branch south of Penticton.
